description: Machine-readable output contract for one plan-autopilot Codex worker slice.

field_contract.blockId: Selected V-block id, for example V145.
field_contract.checks: Array of executed checks with PASS/WARN/FAIL result text.
field_contract.commit: Commit hash for completed, otherwise null.
field_contract.gateReason: Reason text for gate_required or blocked, otherwise null.
field_contract.notChecked: Array of intentionally skipped checks or surfaces.
field_contract.changedFiles: Array of repo-relative files changed by this worker.

safety_rules: changedFiles must be within the selected allowedFiles.
Worker must stop instead of editing when USER-GATE, D3, D4, dirty unrelated files, scope expansion, or red text signals appear.
